title: lore init notice names --agents (alias of --claude) as a Codex flag
description:
The bare-init notice added in LCLI-771 (#691), src/commands/init.ts:1983, ends "Re-run in a terminal, or pass the flags: --codex --agents --yes --tracker <quest|backlog|jira>." In lore, `--agents` is an alias of `--claude` (init.ts:403 "also set up the Claude Code agent bridge"; :2033-2034 "aliases --claude (LCLI-358.2)"), so an operator following the notice literally to set up Codex also gets .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md and CLAUDE.md. Measured on ca31e9ae in scratch git repos: `lore init --codex --agents --yes --tracker none` wrote both bridges; `lore init --codex --yes --tracker none` exited 0, left .claude and CLAUDE.md absent, wrote .agents/skills/lore/SKILL.md and AGENTS.md, and `lore agents --check` then exited 0.

Work: reword the notice so the flags it names do what an operator expects (Codex-only: `--codex --yes --tracker <...>`; name `--claude`/`--agents` separately as the Claude bridge), update the pinning tests, CHANGELOG and any docs that quote the notice, and check the quest-cli twin text (QCLI-543) for the same shape. Ships in the ODOC-556 paired release ahead of the cut. Source: operator-checklist review, lore-cli worker, 2026-10-31. Do not start the fix until the leader's brief arrives (dispatch-floor on --paths src/commands/init.ts).
implementationNotes: Fixed: init.ts wizardSkippedNotice now says "--codex --yes --tracker <quest|backlog|jira|none> (add --claude for the Claude bridge)". New test in test/init.test.ts reads the flags back out of the notice, runs them in a scratch repo and asserts .claude and CLAUDE.md absent, .agents/skills/lore/SKILL.md and AGENTS.md present. Mutations: re-adding --agents reddened exactly the new test; swapping --codex for --claude reddened the new test plus the LCLI-771 naming test (both predicted). quest twin (QCLI-543, read from quest-cli working tree src/cli/init-gate.ts:49, not by ref): hint is --agent-instructions --target <claude|codex|antigravity>, explicit; no change made.
finalSummary: Fixed in this PR (lore-cli#696). The bare-init notice (src/commands/init.ts wizardSkippedNotice) now says "--codex --yes --tracker <quest|backlog|jira|none> (add --claude for the Claude bridge)" instead of naming --agents, an alias of --claude. A new test in test/init.test.ts extracts the flag line from the shipped notice, runs it in a scratch repo and asserts no .claude/ or CLAUDE.md and the two Codex files present; mutations (re-adding --agents; swapping --codex for --claude) reddened the predicted tests. CHANGELOG line added.
